title: Obligations, violation et conformité dans un contrat de livraison
scenario: un contrat de livraison de marchandises entre deux societes fictives, avec delai de livraison

definitions.Obligation: a Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action to which a Bearer is legally bound, and which, if it is not achieved or performed, results in a Violation.
definitions.Violation: an indication that an Obligation or Prohibition has been violated.
definitions.Compliance: an indication that an Obligation has been fulfilled or a Prohibition has not been violated.
definitions.Bearer: a role in a Deontic Specification to which the Deontic Specification is primarily directed.

title: Permissions, droits et interdictions dans un règlement d'accès aux données
scenario: le reglement interieur fictif d'un organisme qui gere des donnees de sante

definitions.Permission: a Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action where the Bearer has no Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary. A weak Permission is the absence of the Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary; a strong Permission is an exception or derogation of the Obligation or Prohibition to the contrary.
definitions.Right: (see also Permission) a Deontic Specification that gives a Permission to a party (the Bearer) and implies there are Obligations or Prohibitions on other parties (the AuxiliaryParty) such that the Bearer can (eventually) exercise the Right.
definitions.Prohibition: a Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action to which a Bearer is legally bound, and which, if it is achieved or performed, results in a Violation.
definitions.AuxiliaryParty: a role in a Deontic Specification to which the Deontic Specification is related.

title: Règles strictes, défaisables et exceptions dans un régime de remboursement
scenario: un regime fictif de remboursement de frais avec des cas d'exception

definitions.StrictStrength: an indication that where the antecedent of a Legal Rule is indisputable, the conclusion of the Legal Rule is indisputable.
definitions.DefeasibleStrength: an indication that, in the absence of information to the contrary and where the antecedent of a Legal Rule holds, the conclusion of the Legal Rule holds.
definitions.Defeater: an indication that, in the absence of information to the contrary and where the antecedent of a Legal Rule holds, the opposite of the conclusion of the Legal Rule does not hold.
definitions.Strength: the quality of a Legal Rule to resist or not to resist a rebuttal.
definitions.RuleStatement: a Legal Statement modelled by a Legal Rule.

title: Priorité entre règles : la loi spéciale l'emporte sur la loi générale
scenario: deux textes fictifs sur la duree d'un preavis, l'un general, l'autre sectoriel

definitions.Override: an indication that a Legal Rule takes precedence over another Legal Rule. The ordered pair of Legal Rules is an instance in a defeasible priority relation.
definitions.OverrideStatement: a Legal Statement of an Override.
definitions.RuleStatement: a Legal Statement modelled by a Legal Rule.
definitions.Strength: the quality of a Legal Rule to resist or not to resist a rebuttal.
definitions.Statement: a Legal Statement or a FactualStatement.

title: Sanctions et réparations liées à une obligation
scenario: une clause penale fictive en cas de retard de paiement

definitions.PenaltyStatement: a Legal Statement of a sanction (e.g. a punishment or a correction).
definitions.Reparation: an indication that a PenaltyStatement is linked with a PrescriptiveStatement. It indicates that a sanction may apply where the PrescriptiveStatement entails a Deontic Specification and when there is a Violation of the Deontic Specification.
definitions.ReparationStatement: a Legal Statement of a Reparation.
definitions.PrescriptiveStatement: a Legal Statement which prescribes behaviours, e.g. with Permissions, Obligations, or Prohibitions on states, actions, or courses of actions.
definitions.Obligation: a Deontic Specification for a state, an act, or a course of action to which a Bearer is legally bound, and which, if it is not achieved or performed, results in a Violation.

title: Temps et statut juridique d'une norme : entrée en vigueur et abrogation
scenario: un decret fictif qui entre en vigueur, est modifie puis abroge

definitions.TemporalCharacteristic: a pair of Time with a qualification, which consists of a Legal Status and a Status Development, such that the qualification holds at the Time.
definitions.LegalStatus: a standing that can apply to a Legal Norm at a Time, e.g., "is applicable", "is in force", "has efficacy", "is valid".
definitions.StatusDevelopment: a kind of event (e.g., start, end) that changes the Legal Status of a Legal Norm, e.g. making a Legal Norm in force.
definitions.Times: a collection where every member is a Time.
definitions.Context: an application of Associations to their target entities within a Scope.

title: Autorités, juridictions et sources du droit
scenario: une competence territoriale fictive entre deux regions et leurs autorites

definitions.Authority: a person or organization with the power to create, endorse, or enforce Legal Norms.
definitions.Jurisdiction: a geographic area or subject-matter over which an Authority applies its legal power.
definitions.LegalSource: a source of one or more Legal Norms formulated in any format and endorsed by an Authority.
definitions.LegalReference: a Reference whose Source is a LegalSource.
definitions.Source: a source formulated in any format.

title: Acteurs, agents, rôles et figures dans un contrat de location
scenario: un bail d'habitation fictif entre un bailleur, un locataire et un mandataire

definitions.Agent: an entity that acts or has the capability to act.
definitions.Figure: an instantiation of a function by an Actor.
definitions.Role: a function of or part played by an Actor relative to a LegalRuleML expression.
definitions.Bearer: a role in a Deontic Specification to which the Deontic Specification is primarily directed.

title: Énoncés constitutifs, prescriptifs et factuels dans un code de conduite
scenario: un code de conduite fictif qui definit des termes, prescrit des comportements et constate des faits

definitions.ConstitutiveStatement: a Legal Statement that defines concepts and does not prescribe behaviours.
definitions.PrescriptiveStatement: a Legal Statement which prescribes behaviours, e.g. with Permissions, Obligations, or Prohibitions on states, actions, or courses of actions.
definitions.LogicalFormulaStatement: a statement modelled by a logical formula.
definitions.Statement: a Legal Statement or a FactualStatement.

title: Contextes, lectures alternatives et paraphrases d'un même article
scenario: un article fictif de loi lu de deux manieres par deux autorites differentes

definitions.Context: an application of Associations to their target entities within a Scope.
definitions.Association: a partial description of the extension of some relations where each non-target entity is paired with every target entity.
definitions.Alternative: a LegalRuleML rendering of one or more Legal Norms.
definitions.Alternatives: a mutually exclusive collection where every member is a LegalRuleML rendering of one or more Legal Norms.
definitions.Paraphrase: a natural language rendering of a Legal Rule or fragment of it that is an alternative to its Legal Source(s).
definitions.LegalRuleMLDocument: a formal representation of one or more LegalSources using the LegalRuleML Specifications.
